profile: Blender5.3.0 nativeCPU; Chromium Metal WebGL2 built browser preflight
observation: TSL int/uint bitcast emitted float reinterpret intermediates and a uint-returning uint_to_int helper. Native source uses pure numeric signed/unsigned casts. This counterexample initially motivated replacing those casts; causal attribution awaits the next exact differential run.
resolution: Replacing all IntegerBits int/uint TSLbitcast calls with pure uint()/int() casts removed the float reinterpret helper from generated GLSL and resolved the exact reproducer. Complete297case Metal WebGPU+WebGL2 and SwiftShader WebGPU+WebGL2 raw suites pass. Lower-driver optimization mechanics are not independently attributed.
regression: browser.js wraps actual backend.createProgram and rejects GLSL intBitsToFloat/uintBitsToFloat/floatBitsToInt/floatBitsToUint whenever an IntegerBits shader compiles; every API receipt records positive integerShaderCompiles and integerFloatBitcasts=0.
